column2: A vendor overbilled my team and then stopped responding. Should I handle it professionally through normal billing channels, or should I retaliate by making their account look bad internally?

5. **Maintain Professionalism**: Retaliating or trying to make their account look bad can harm your reputation and may have negative consequences for your team. It's important to remain professional and ethical in all dealings.

Keeping a professional attitude will serve you better in the long run and help maintain good working relationships.
